name: Haruna Yuuma
source:
Miyamae Haruna's senpai at the tennis club. 

Serious and hardworking, as well as a gentle appearance, he earns respect from everyone. He belongs to the tennis club, but is currently in rehabilitation due to an injury. He is closer to Haruna than other members as they share the same surname.
He has a rough period in the past, and to avoid trouble he moved from another prefecture when he went to college.

He makes a move against Haruna to get her heart, mind and body for his own benefit.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc044/character.html]the official site[/url]]
